title: Walking in Others’ Shoes: How Perspective-Taking Guides Large Language Models in Reducing Toxicity and Bias
reasoning: The paper focuses on reducing toxicity and social bias (gender and race) in LLMs. Although it cites social psychology theories of moral reasoning and includes a thematic quote from the Bible (Proverbs), the core empirical evaluation is centered on language detoxification and demographic debiasing rather than benchmarking religion, faith, or specific ethical frameworks.
